# neuron v0.1.7 — safer macros and sharing, steadier runtime

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). Installer and portable ZIP, with the app and CLI. Unsigned binaries; check `SHA256SUMS.txt`. `SOURCE.txt` records the source commit.

This release includes the fixes from v0.1.6, which was not published.

- **Macros:** BOUND macros are walled off from files, programs and the network, can drive OBS and Signal lighting, and report whether an action happened. New [macro API reference](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.7/docs/reference/MACROS.md).
- **Sharing setups:** importing a setup or profile lists anything that would run code or write device memory, and asks you to opt in.
- **Devices:** better automatic lighting for newer BlackWidow keyboards (untested on those boards). Device files can only send commands Neuron understands. Keyboards adopted after startup get M-key input without a restart.
- **Reliability:** no false stall warnings after sleep, a clean quit from the tray, and Chroma broker updates that roll back on failure.
- **Updates and install:** the updater checks what it runs and where it downloads from, and setup, update and removal leave other Neuron copies alone.
- **Lighting:** fixes for lighting ownership after a host restart and OpenRGB single-LED updates.

No new hardware support is claimed. [Feature status and platform limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.7/docs/STATUS.md).
